83:36.text: for what they used to do?

84:1.text: When the heaven is split asunder,

84:2.text: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

84:3.text: And when the earth is stretched forth,

84:4.text: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.

84:5.text: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

84:6.text: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions
, a sure returning, and you will meet
(the results of your deeds which you did)

84:7.text: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

84:8.text: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

84:9.text: And will return to his family in joy!

84:10.text: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

84:12.text: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning.

84:13.text: Verily, he was among his people in joy!

84:14.text: Verily, he thought that he would never come back

84:15.text: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

84:16.text: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;

84:17.text: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,

84:18.text: And by the moon when it is at the full.

84:19.text: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage
(in this life and in the Hereafter)

84:20.text: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?

84:21.text: And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.

84:22.text: (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.)

84:23.text: And Allâh knows best what they gather

84:24.text: So announce to them a painful torment.

84:25.text: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end
